paper.title: Efficient Jailbreak Mitigation Using Semantic Linear Classification in a Multi-Staged Pipeline

labels.benign: No attempt to bypass safety or alter application/system instructions.
labels.jailbreak: Attempts to make a model violate safety policy or produce prohibited content.
labels.prompt-injection: Attempts to manipulate application logic, system instructions, tool use, or downstream execution.

labeling_as_reported_by_paper: Combines source-provided annotations, rule-based validation, and manual verification; classes are described as mutually exclusive.
license_status: The code repository has a license, but the aggregated raw prompt files do not establish a single data license; check source-level terms before reuse.
